beats.headline: Meta Connect 2026 unveils Muse glasses, voice, video and Charm
Private Processing arrives on glasses as Alibaba's Qwen glasses enter the market
beats.summary: Meta publishes its confidential-computing design; Alibaba positions its Qwen glasses against Meta's eyewear.

open_questions: Will Meta publish an independent audit or attestation verifier for glasses Private Processing?
Will Meta or third parties open the glasses to developer-built agents?

status.detail: Meta's glasses line now has a published privacy architecture and its first named competitor from Alibaba.

editorial.take_for_builders: If you send wearable or camera data to cloud models, compare your pipeline with Meta's design: TEE-based processing, remote attestation, anonymous credentials and OHTTP routing.
editorial.tldr: 9월 24일 Meta Connect는 Muse 안경, 음성, 영상을 Meta 하드웨어 전략의 중심에 놓았습니다. 3주 뒤부터 AI 안경을 둘러싼 경쟁과 프라이버시 문제가 떠오르기 시작했습니다.
editorial.whats_new: Meta extended Private Processing to its AI glasses on Oct 14, running AI workloads in confidential VMs and TEEs with remote attestation; Alibaba's Qwen glasses launched the same day as a rival.
editorial.why_it_matters: Always-on camera glasses send sensor data to cloud models, so the trust boundary matters. Meta's attested TEE design is a reference pattern for any team shipping on-device-plus-cloud AI.
